description: This file implements forward automatic differentiation (forward AD) utilities for PyTorch, including context managers, dual tensor creation, and unpacking functions for forward gradient computations.

classes.name: UnpackedDualTensor
classes.description: NamedTuple containing the primal and tangent components of a dual tensor.

classes.name: dual_level
classes.description: Context manager for forward automatic differentiation (forward AD) levels.

classes.name: _set_fwd_grad_enabled
classes.description: Context manager to enable or disable forward gradient computation.

methods.name: enter_dual_level
methods.description: Enters a new forward AD level for computing forward gradients.

methods.name: exit_dual_level
methods.description: Exits the current forward AD level, deleting associated gradients.

methods.name: make_dual
methods.description: Creates a dual tensor by associating a tensor with its tangent for forward AD.

methods.name: unpack_dual
methods.description: Unpacks a dual tensor into its primal and tangent components.
